mechanism: Torsemide causes loop diuretic-induced electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which increases risk of QT prolongation and arrhythmias; famotidine has minimal direct interaction but both drugs can affect electrolyte balance indirectly.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, magnesium) regularly; consider potassium-sparing agent or supplementation if concurrent use is necessary; perform baseline and periodic ECG monitoring.
